usage_notice_text: This site is intended to provide a visual representation of the voting data made available by the Hardin County Elections Department. Results are unofficial.
notes: Seed host www.co.hardin.tx.us is unreachable through the fetch module (robots check: connection reset by peer); one web search found the current site hardincountytx.gov, whose Elections Department page links 'HCElectionCenter' (hcelectioncenter.hardincountytx.gov/results/, a county-built results map run by the Hardin County Technology Department) plus official cumulative PDFs/TXT. HCElectionCenter shows per-precinct candidate votes (precinctCandidateVotes) for the 2024 general (election/5) and the 2026 primaries (election/8 and 9), but every race is stamped 'Last Updated' in March or April 2026 (for example 2024 general 'Last Updated: March 24, 2026 - 11:17 AM'; Republican primary 'Last Updated: April 6, 2026 - 1:27 PM'; Democratic primary 'Last Updated: March 26, 2026 - 2:22 PM'), so the current pages show reloaded data, not the election-night state, and the site exposes no update history. The 2026 runoff is 'PDF only' on HCElectionCenter. Official files on hardincountytx.gov are county cumulative reports (2024 general 'OFFICIAL Cumulative Results-11-18-2024', 2026 primaries '...-3-12-2026', runoff '...-6-4-2026'). No Clarity site linked. Check 3 pending (wayback-data branch not on origin).
tag_rationale: Only the 2026 runoff is determined (LATER: county totals on election night, precinct numbers never posted), so the tag is COUNTY_ONLY_PRECINCT_AT_CANVASS with confidence low as the rule requires for a single determined election.

2024_general.fact: HCElectionCenter election/5 now shows per-precinct votes (e.g. 'Donald Trump ... 87.7% (24,688 votes) ... 19 of 19 precincts reporting (100%)'), but races are stamped 'Last Updated: March 20, 2026' to 'March 24, 2026', so when precinct numbers first appeared is unknown. Official file: 'OFFICIAL Cumulative Results-11-18-2024' (county totals). Check 3 pending.

2026_primary.fact: HCElectionCenter election/9 (Republican) and election/8 (Democratic) show per-precinct votes, stamped 'Last Updated: April 6, 2026 - 1:27 PM' and 'Last Updated: March 26, 2026 - 2:22 PM'; election-night state not shown. Official cumulative files dated 3-12-2026. Check 3 pending.

2026_runoff.fact: HCElectionCenter lists the runoff as 'May 26, 2026 (PDF only)'. The PDF is 'Cumulative Results Report HARDIN COUNTY, TEXAS Unofficial Results ... REPUBLICAN & DEMOCRATIC PRIMARY RUNOFF ELECTION ... Run Time 8:41 PM Run Date 05/26/2026' with county totals by Absentee, Early and Election Day Voting; Last-Modified Wed, 27 May 2026 02:15:57 GMT (9:15 PM CDT). Only official cumulative county reports (6-4-2026) follow; no precinct numbers posted online.
